method.sceneP99Summary: arithmetic mean of four per-scene P99 values, NOT a pooled percentile
method.scope: Apple M3 macOS15.8.2; uncapped rendering with 1ms loop sleep, deterministic 60Hz simulation; two maps at actual 1280x960 and 1920x1440 pixels; no timed observers/captures/pixel scans
method.readbackMetric: Sync call or async submission only. Async wait remains inside transfer; runtime destination copying may run inside present. Render/interval/CPU totals include those stages.

behavior.scope: only detected macOS OpenGL Cocoa recovery on an async-capable runtime
behavior.bootstrap: first complete current image is repeated once while starting the stream
behavior.capturesAndObservers: drain pending work and show independent current frame; restart bootstraps again
behavior.failure: repair with synchronous current frame and disable async until resource replacement

limits: One-frame presentation latency and one staging buffer are additional costs.
Small FireRed mean CPU increases about 8.5%; not every scene percentile improves.
Synchronous startup/capture/fallback and async completion can still wait; GPU stalls are mitigated, not eliminated.
External GPU/compositor load uncontrolled on one host; not displayed FPS or GPU timestamps.
No Windows hardware execution or full-gameplay/fullscreen/context-loss/long-duration guarantee.
Previously published native-preview-20261024.1 remains at its original source.
